CITYCLINIC & OPD CARE

Dr. R K Sharma, MD (Medicine) | Reg No: MCI-49210

Date: 12-Oct-2026

Patient Ramesh Kumar, 48M

## Chief Complaints

- Fever for 3 days, dry cough worse at night

- Mild retrosternal chest discomfort

- Known Type 2 DM, Penicillin allergy

Rx (Medicines):

1. Tab Paracetamol 650mg - 1 tab SOS for fever

2. Tab Metformin 500mg - 1 tab BD after meals

3. Syp Dextromethorphan - 10ml TDS x 5 days

4. Tab Azithromycin 500mg - 1 tab OD x 3 days (avoid Penicillins)

Investigations

- Fasting Blood Sugar, HbA1c, CBC, Chest X-ray PA view

Follow up after 3 days. Return immediately if breathlessness develops.

Dr. R K Sharma
